fields.symptoms: Yellowing leaves, honeydew excretion, stunted ear development.
fields.prevention_measures: Sow early in November, conserve ladybird beetle natural predators.
fields.organic_controls: Neem oil emulsion spray (5ml/L) or soap solution.

fields.symptoms: Dead hearts at vegetative stage, white ear heads at panicle stage.
fields.prevention_measures: Clip leaf tips before transplanting, install pheromone traps at 20 traps/ha.

fields.symptoms: Upward leaf curling, chlorosis, yellowing margins, vector for viral transmission.
fields.prevention_measures: Install yellow sticky traps (15-20/acre), net nursery beds with 40-mesh mesh.

fields.symptoms: Mine galleries in leaves and tubers, frass deposits near tuber eyes.
fields.prevention_measures: Ensure good soil earthing up to keep tubers covered 5-7 cm deep.
fields.organic_controls: Store tubers with dried Lantana or Eucalyptus leaves.

fields.symptoms: Ragged whorl feeding, sawdust-like frass inside corn whorls.
fields.prevention_measures: Deep autumn plowing, intercropping with cowpea or desmodium.
fields.organic_controls: Apply Metarhizium anisopliae or neem seed kernel extract (NSKE 5%).
fields.chemical_controls: Spinetoram 11.7 SC or Emamectin benzoate 5 SG.

fields.symptoms: Rosetted flowers, premature boll opening, stained lint inside bolls.
fields.prevention_measures: Use non-Bt refugia border rows, install PB-Rope pheromone dispensers.
fields.chemical_controls: Profex Super or Indoxacarb 14.5 SC spray.
